title: How to spot a scam text, email or call: the patterns that give them away

posts.facebook:
Scams change costume every week. The pressure underneath never does — learn it once and you'll see them all.

The recurring patterns in scam texts, emails and calls — urgency, secrecy, unexpected contact, unusual payment — with the specific costumes they wear, the hang-up-and-call-back rule, and exactly where to report them in the UK and US.

Feel urgency, secrecy or an odd way to pay? Hang up, and call back on the number printed on your card.

Read the full story → https://dontdieretired.com/tech/how-to-spot-a-scam-text-email-or-call/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=daily
